items.quote: The old prophet answered, “I too am a prophet, as you are. And an angel said to me by the word of the Lord: ‘Bring him back with you to your house so that he may eat bread and drink water.’” (But he was lying to him.)
items.contrast: The old prophet as the liar versus the man of God as the person being lied to.
items.reason: Although the pronouns could momentarily be reversed, the old prophet is the speaker in the preceding sentence, so “he” refers to him and “him” refers to the man of God. The question clearly tests actor versus recipient.
